milestones.description: Uses inventory_has with item='cobblestone' because mining stone blocks with a regular iron pickaxe (no Silk Touch) drops cobblestone into the player's inventory. The player must mine through the stone wall barrier at z=3 to proceed, and cobblestone appearing in inventory confirms this action was performed. There is no cobblestone in the starting inventory or scene, so this check has zero false-positive risk.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate to and visually identify the redstone_ore blocks. The target is the center of the 3x2 redstone_ore wall at spawn-relative (0, 0, 5). max_distance=5 ensures the player is in the back chamber close to the ore, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it. The back chamber is only accessible after mining through the stone wall at z=3, enforcing the dependency.
